episode.s1_narration: Six-year-old Mia found a tiny shivering ginger kitten in the rain and brought him home to meet her giant Husky, Titan.
episode.s1_action: Scene 1: Cute 6-year-old girl Mia in a yellow raincoat holding a tiny orange tabby kitten in a hallway, introducing the kitten to a giant silver-and-white Siberian Husky dog
episode.s2_narration: Everyone worried the ninety-pound dog would scare the kitten, but Titan gently laid down and offered his warm furry paw.
episode.s2_action: Scene 2: The giant silver-and-white Siberian Husky dog lying flat on the floor offering his big white front paw to the tiny orange tabby kitten, while the 6-year-old girl watches happily
episode.s3_narration: Within minutes, little Mochi was fast asleep on Titan's chest while Mia covered them both with her favorite soft blanket.
episode.s3_action: Scene 3: The tiny orange tabby kitten sleeping peacefully on top of the giant Siberian Husky dog's chest by a fireplace, while the 6-year-old girl places a soft blanket over the dog and cat
episode.s4_narration: Now the three best friends wear matching blue scarves everywhere they go! Subscribe if Mia and Mochi made you smile!
episode.s4_action: Scene 4: The 6-year-old girl, the giant Siberian Husky dog, and the tiny orange tabby kitten sitting side by side on green grass wearing matching blue scarves, smiling at camera
episode.title: Little Girl Brings Stray Kitten Home to Her 90-Pound Husky
